tasks.goal: TCP inventoryが非data行の01を誤countする不具合
tasks.interface: Preserve existing signatures, surrounding source and all protected tests. Debug count_established_tcp(text: &str) -> usize. Count a line iff it has at least four whitespace-separated fields, the first is one or more ASCII decimal digits followed by exactly one colon, and the fourth is exactly 01. Do not validate the address fields; IPv4/IPv6 opaque fields and extra columns are accepted. Preserve duplicates, leading whitespace and CRLF. Reject headers, empty slots, signed/non-ASCII/malformed slot numbers and other states. This fixes one data-row predicate, not the observer or a whole network parser.
